EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
NOTICE UNDER SECTION 10A(1)(a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
Kalmunai Municipal Council

I, Don Thilina Ishan Wickramarathna, Returning Officer of the Kalmunai Municipal Council, do hereby declare underSection 10A(1)(a) of the (Chapter 262) Local Authorities Elections Ordinance that Mr. Kaththamuththu Ganesh of theKalmunai Municipal Council has vacated his office of that Municipal Council as he has ceased to be a member of theTamil United Liberation Front.
THILINA WICKRAMARATHNA,Returning Officer,Kalmunai Municipal Council.
District Election Office,Ampara,28th November, 2019.

NOTICE UNDER SECTION 10A(1)(a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
Kalmunai Municipal Council

I, Don Thilina Ishan Wickramarathna, Returning Officer of the Kalmunai Municipal Council, do hereby declare underSection 10A(1)(a) of the (Chapter 262) Local Authorities Elections Ordinance that Mrs. Sumithra Jegatheesan of theKalmunai Municipal Council has vacated her office of that Municipal Council as she has ceased to be a member of theTamil United Liberation Front.
THILINA WICKRAMARATHNA,Returning Officer,Kalmunai Municipal Council.
District Election Office,Ampara,28th November, 2019.
